g.text: Detention stores inflow temporarily while its outlet releases water more slowly

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Linear outlet example with routing time K=2 hours and zero initial storage. Flow curves, storage, and stage share one balance. Signed area between I and O
must be multiplied by3600 when time is in hours to obtain m³; the shaded flow-rate area is not a storage-axis ordinate. Tail storage remains positive at14
